definitions.explanation: A structured game or play activity, especially those played by children or in educational settings. More formal than 遊び and often implies organized or rule-based activities. Composed of 遊 (play) + 戯 (frolic).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{遊戯|ゆうぎ}をしている。
examples.english: The children are playing a game.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園|ようちえん}では{毎日|まいにち}{遊戯|ゆうぎ}の{時間|じかん}がある。
examples.english: There is playtime every day at kindergarten.

examples.japanese: {遊戯|ゆうぎ}{室|しつ}で{子|こ}どもたちが{楽|たの}しそうに{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: The children were having fun playing in the playroom.

notes:
USAGE:
{遊戯|ゆうぎ} is more formal and literary than {遊|あそ}び. It is commonly used in educational and institutional contexts (kindergartens, childcare facilities). Also well known from the manga and anime title {遊☆戯☆王|ゆうぎおう} (Yu-Gi-Oh!).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊戯|ゆうぎ}{室|しつ} (playroom)
- {遊戯|ゆうぎ}{王|おう} (King of Games — the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise)
- {遊戯|ゆうぎ}{施設|しせつ} (amusement facility)
- お{遊戯|ゆうぎ} (children's performance, play — polite form used in kindergartens)
